assets.caption: Exhibit 10-28a. Maintenance Access Elevations. Side-by-side vessel elevation sketches: left vessel labeled TRAYED TOWER shows a vertical cylindrical tower with internal trays, a top dimension '1/2 D MIN' above a manway, 'T.L.' (tangent line) near the bottom head, and a 'NOZZLE DIAMETER + 5"/125 MIN' dimension between the lower T.L. and the bottom nozzle; right vessel labeled PACKED TOWER shows a vertical cylindrical tower with a packed bed (hatched region) and a side manway/access, with an arrow labeled 'MAINTENANCE ACCESS TO BE LEVEL WITH TOP OF PACKING SUPPORT'.

Exhibit 10-28b. Maintenance Access Orientations. Two plan-view (top-down) circular tower cross-sections: left circle labeled SINGLE DOWNCOMER TRAY shows a single chord-shaped downcomer area shaded with the remaining arc segments labeled 'MAINTENANCE ACCESS SEGMENTS (TYPICAL)'; right circle labeled DOUBLE DOWNCOMER TRAY shows two opposing chord-shaped 'DOWNCOMER AREAS' with the perpendicular arc segments between them serving as the maintenance access segments.
